name: Fuse whelp
description: a small yellow-orange demon whelp of the Cracked Road with sticks of dynamite-like glowing rock strapped to its back, a short fuse burning and sputtering sparks on its head

poses.stand: mid-run on all fours, the burning fuse sputtering on its back, wild eyes, facing right
poses.struck: struck: the fuse flaring, the whelp tumbling
poses.dead: flash of white light and a scatter of sparks where it stood

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
